purpose: Teach: 覆い/明かさ/少数/気がつい/人民/調和/振れ/成人

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は事実を覆い隠そうとしていました
lines.en: In this case, the suspect was attempting to conceal the facts.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, measured pace. Professional distance but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'attempting' — a factual observation, not judgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、まだ犯人像を明かさないご方針ですね
lines.en: So the police are still maintaining discretion about the suspect's profile, I see.
lines.style: Respectful inquiry, careful phrasing. Seeking clarification without pushback. Slight upward inflection at the end — genuine question, not challenge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、少数の目撃証言を慎重に扱っております
lines.en: We're handling the witness statements very carefully at this stage.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Slightly formal register. Even pacing. Reassuring without over-explaining — the speech of someone used to giving official statements.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察が気がついた手がかり、すばらしいです
lines.en: That's excellent detective work on the part of your team.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation. Warm but not effusive. Acknowledges competence without flattery. Slight pause before speaking — choosing words with care.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、人民の安全を最優先にしております
lines.en: Public safety remains our highest priority in all of this.
lines.style: Firm, principled tone. Steady rhythm like a statement of purpose. No defensive edge — just clear conviction. Professional composure throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地域の調和を保つご努力、警察ありがたいです
lines.en: Your efforts to maintain harmony in the community are something we're truly grateful for.
lines.style: Sincere and deferential. Slower pace than before — the weight of genuine thanks. Slight softening in the voice. Respecting authority without kowtowing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の証言に振れがあると判断しております
lines.en: We've noted inconsistencies in the suspect's account that warrant further investigation.
lines.style: Controlled precision. Each phrase lands deliberately. Professional but not distant — the tone of someone sharing information they take seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、成人前の少年は警察、保護対応ですね
lines.en: And minors will naturally receive protective measures throughout this process, I imagine.
lines.style: Gentle close. Thoughtful, almost trailing-off quality. Concern for the vulnerable showing through respect for procedure. Soft landing on the final phrase.
